Workspace XML, version 4

The file a workspace exports from Settings and imports back: its settings, accessory catalogue, floor plan and configuration. Ids, members, bookings, money and secrets never travel. Validate a file with schema.xsd. Times are ISO 8601 UTC; grid coordinates are cells.

<deskilo-workspace>

In (root). The document: one workspace configuration.

AttributeTypeRequiredSinceMeaning
versionnonNegativeIntegeryesv1The format version; this app writes 4 and reads 1 to 4.

<configuration>

In deskilo-workspace · since v3. Every other configuration domain (tariffs, legal identity, rules, designs, sites) as a typed tree. Secrets never travel.

<field>

In deskilo-workspace/configuration · since v3. One value of the tree. Object members are sorted by name, array items keep their order; a field nests in a field.

AttributeTypeRequiredSinceMeaning
